purpose: Constructed observational-method review component pilot; not end-to-end discovery or domain validation
reviewDisclosure: User-requested AI role-based methods review by the same implementation agent; no human medical credentials. Reviewer saw aggregate results and condition labels for seven overflagged outputs before rating. This is post hoc self-review, not independent or blinded domain validation.
limitations: Four constructed public cases, authored with the implementation; no external domain benchmark or novel scientific findings.
Three repeats per case remain grouped as four independent cases; no significance or general superiority claim.
Raw report is retained unchanged. Parent modules were captured during, rather than committed before, this first live pilot; future protocols freeze their hashes and instructions before dispatch.
The installed Codex transport does not forward maxTokens. Output/token ceilings are audited after responses; an already dispatched response can overrun. No observed output ceiling overruns.
Same-user adapter processes are not isolated by an OS sandbox. Rubric answers were withheld from method payloads.
Persona ratings are post hoc self-review, with aggregate and partial condition-label exposure. They are not independent human domain review.
No retry, fallback, prompt tuning, or rubric rescore was used to improve these observed results.
